lessons_used: Reordering sign-in after adoption (sign_in, reorder) was helpful (+7.0%), though a second test showed no clear effect.
Adding a new flow on home (home, new_flow) and quality guidance hints for adoption (adoption, hint) were helpful (+8.6% and +5.4%).
Streamlining path selection copy (choose_path, copy) hurt performance (-4.7%).
Grid selection layouts, background notifications, desktop tutorial screens, wait info/hints, copy updates, and interactive path story arcs showed no clear effect.
Predictions were generally too optimistic overall, but a new home flow strongly outperformed its prediction (+8.6% measured vs +1.0% predicted).

candidates.title: Desktop Placement Verification Flow
candidates.change: Adds an automated screen check and workspace rendering test right after waiting to confirm the pet displays properly.
candidates.why: Three support emails reported pets not showing up on desktop or the app failing to open, and home waiting time has a high mean of 2336s.

new_placement_test.headline: Verifying Desktop Display
new_placement_test.body: Checking desktop resolution and screen positioning to make sure your pet appears properly.

guard.reason: Adds a verification screen after waiting and before home intro, which is allowed inside onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Strong precedent for home new_flow (+8.6%) and strong evidence from wait time plus support emails, but requires new flow development.

candidates.title: Account Sync Restore Explanation Hint
candidates.change: Adds explicit hint copy explaining that signing into a previous account restores existing pets while new emails start a fresh companion profile.
candidates.why: 8 support emails (the top issue) reported pets missing or reset after signing in again.

sign_in.hint: Sign in with your previous account to restore existing pets, or use a new email to start fresh.

guard.reason: text in 'sign_in.hint' asks for or mentions personal data

candidates.title: Pet Control Summary Screen
candidates.change: Adds a final setup screen detailing system tray shortcuts, hiding/showing pet toggles, and interaction commands.
candidates.why: Finish completion drops to 64.8% and 3 support emails reported confusion on how to control, hide, or talk to the pet after setup.

new_control_summary.headline: Quick Desktop Controls
new_control_summary.body: Right-click your desktop pet or use the system tray icon anytime to hide, show, or open pet chat controls.

guard.reason: Adds a desktop control summary screen following home intro, which is explicitly permitted.

candidates.score_note: High drop-off step and direct support emails, but adding new screens previously yielded negative lift (-0.4%).

candidates.title: Photo Generation Retry Stage Redesign
candidates.change: Redesigns photo upload into a stage layout featuring live validation previewing alongside custom upload controls.
candidates.why: Adoption step has low 64.2% completion and high mean time (1017s), with 3 support emails noting custom pet creation failures.

guard.reason: 'upload_photos.replace.photo_upload[1]': a preview cannot do the photo_upload job (use ['button', 'checklist', 'image', 'photo_picker', 'text'])

candidates.title: Stage Path Selector Layout
candidates.change: Changes the path selection step layout to a clear stage view highlighting companion path choice cards.
candidates.why: choose_path has a high mean duration of 514s, indicating users get stuck or hesitate on the default layout.

guard.reason: replacement for 'choose_path.path_options' does not do the job (two distinct choices: adopting a friend and making your own): needs 2 of ['button', 'choice_cards'] with real words

candidates.title: Background Pet Preparation Progress
candidates.change: Enables progress bar and time estimate display on the waiting screen while background assets build.
candidates.why: The waiting step on home has a long median of 201s and mean of 2336s, leading to drop-off before reaching home.

guard.reason: Displays progress bar and estimated time on waiting screen during an actual background build process.

candidates.score_note: Funnel shows long wait times, but wait info updates previously tested negative (-0.5%) with no support mail backing.

candidates.title: Adoption Certificate Name Lock Incentive
candidates.change: Adds an official adoption badge and styled name input component to solidify pet adoption commitment.
candidates.why: Adoption conversion drops to 64.2% with a long mean duration of 1017s.

guard.reason: Adds an official adoption seal badge and pet name input to the adoption certificate screen.

candidates.score_note: Targeting a high drop-off step (35.8% lost) with UI component updates, though lacking support email evidence.

candidates.title: Desktop Tray Quick Launch Copy
candidates.change: Updates home introduction headline and body copy to directly explain where to locate the pet on the screen and system tray.
candidates.why: Multiple support emails noted post-onboarding confusion on finding and interacting with the pet on the desktop.

home_intro.headline: Your Pet is Active on Your Desktop!
home_intro.body: Look for your pet on your primary display or click the system tray icon anytime to open controls.

guard.reason: Updates home intro copy to explain desktop placement and system tray controls.

candidates.score_note: Low cost copy update backed by support complaints and positive history for finish copy (+3.7%).

candidates.title: Sign In Delay To Final Setup Stage
candidates.change: Moves the sign-in screen to after the home waiting step, right before the final introduction.
candidates.why: Reordering sign-in later previously provided a +7.0% boost by allowing users to complete pet creation before account sign-in friction.

guard.reason: Reorders sign-in step to occur after waiting, which is explicitly allowed by onboarding rules.

candidates.score_note: Reordering sign_in has proven positive results (+3.6% to +7.0% measured across past tests).

candidates.title: Path Switch Flexibility Hint
candidates.change: Adds a hint informing users that chosen companion paths can be changed or expanded anytime later in settings.
candidates.why: High mean time on choose_path (514s) indicates hesitation; explicit flexibility reduces decision friction.

choose_path.hint: You can change companion paths or add new pets anytime in app settings after onboarding.

guard.reason: Adds an informative flexibility hint to the choose path screen.

candidates.score_note: Low implementation cost, but path selection copy/hints have shown negative or negligible historical impact.

lessons_next: Reordering sign-in after adoption (sign_in, reorder) yielded a win (+7.0%), though a second attempt showed no clear effect.
Introducing a new flow on home (home, new_flow) and quality guidance hints for adoption (adoption, hint) were helpful (+8.6% and +5.4%).
Streamlining path selection copy (choose_path, copy) hurt performance (-4.7%).
Layout updates, background notifications, tutorial screens, incentives, copy changes, and general hints showed no clear effect.
Predictions were generally too optimistic, overestimating gains for most tests.
Predictions were too low for the winning home new flow (+1.0% predicted vs +8.6% measured).
